Homepage forms: 0 Visible homepage text: About | The Good Dogs Club top of page The Good Dogs Club Home Services About Testimonials My Favourite Products Prices Contact FAQ What's so different about The Good Dogs Club? It's hard to set yourself apart in and industry that has grown exponentially since the pandemic. Did you know roughly 29% of people now own a pet dog- this means that there are over 11 Million in the UK alone! The numbers suggest that there are probably enough dogs to be walked by the hundreds of walkers there already are. So why the GDC? I pride myself on building a rapport with you and your dog. I own two dogs myself and really am picky about who looks after them. I know your dog is another member of the family and I go to any lengths to make sure they enjoy a safe, stimulating and suitably tiring time on every walk they come on! I tick all the boxes when it comes to insurance, DBS checks, public liability and formal qualifications and will happily share any and all of these on request. I am reliable, honest, dedicated and promise to love your pup as if it were my own every time I am out with them. I believe your dog will tell you all you need to know about me, and when they have a wonderful time, they will be wagging happily to see me again and soon I'll be the highlight of their week! At the GDC we walk in all weathers (43% of owners skip a dog walk due to bad weather!) no judgement from me at all - I secretly prefer the miserable weather- it's much less peopley outside! ©2022 by The Good Dogs Club.
